MCP registration (dashboard, no file to edit):
  1. Open the KiroCrew dashboard, MCP Servers page, and add a server.
  2. Name: founder-vn. Command: uvx. Arguments: --from founder-vn founder-vn-mcp.
  3. Trust the project in KiroCrew; it loads skills and servers only for a trusted project.
KiroCrew does not read the workspace .kiro/settings/mcp.json.

Model calls read FOUNDER_LLM_BASE_URL, FOUNDER_LLM_API_KEY and FOUNDER_LLM_MODEL from the
host environment. Set them there; never write their values into a config file or the repository.
